latency_targets: p50 < 60ms, p95 < 200ms for chat generation (8-12 token bursts); tail tolerances defined per route; summarization p95 < 400ms
throughput_requirements: Sustained 150 qps across model endpoints during clinic peak; bursts up to 650 qps for 2-3 minutes (expect 4x concurrency spike windows)
reserved_gpu_plan: Baseline reserved pool: 8x A100 (or equivalent), headroom for +4 GPUs burst; plan to map model variants to smaller instance types after quantization tests
scaling_policy_summary: Scale-up: proactive warm-pool warmup when queue > 25 reqs or CPU/GPU util > 70% for 15s; scale-out step increments of 2 GPUs; cooldown 90s. Scale-down: conserve warm pool (min 2 nodes) with graceful cache drain; avoid scale-down if queue > 5 for last 60s. Manual override for clinic hours.
queueing_behavior: Queue priority by route (chat > summarization > background embeddings). Max queue length 500; overflow policy = spill to queued retry with exponential backoff and eventual fallback to hosted read-only model for non-PHI content. Metrics: queue depth, age, and oldest-request age exported to Redwood Console.
poc_plan: 2-week Dedicated POC: reserve 8 GPUs in VPC-connected Dedicated cluster. Week 1: baseline perf tests (cold starts, warm pool sizing, KV hits, batching). Week 2: failure injection + scale events (simulated 4x spike) + end-to-end latency SLO validation. Deliverables: perf report, recommended autoscale config, SOW draft for production reserved capacity.
